{{Quote|Durr and the White Thranta company are a front for illegal activities for Jabba the Hutt.|[[Reimos Taligg]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Digital Infection|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
'''Durr Roddack''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was a manager in the [[White Thranta Shipping Company]], a front for the illegal activities of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|criminal organization]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|So Durr was stealing from his own company? Maybe we can get this boss of his to answer for their shared crimes.|Reimos Taligg, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:SO" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Durr Roddack was a manager in the White Thranta Shipping Company, a front for the illegal activities of Jabba the Hutt's criminal organization. Director of Operations [[Brok Ziam]] was his immediate superior.<ref name="SWG:SO" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Durr Roddack stole plans for a military prototype [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]], without Jabba being aware of it. The [[Spy/Legends|spymaster]] [[Kaesii DuPree]] then dispatched a spy to infiltrate the [[White Thranta Shipping offices|White Thranta Shipping base]] to recover the plans. After the spy succeeded in the mission, Kaesii DuPre contacted one of Roddack's rivals to announce that she could sell him the plans. Durr Roddack learnt about the offer and started panicking, thereby convincing DuPre and her buyer that the plans were authentic. Finally, Kaesii DuPree threatened Roddack to reveal the theft of the plans to Jabba and
blackmailed him to get extra money.<ref name="SWG:SLU">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Spy|Spies Like Us|Tatooine}}</ref>

Around the same time, a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] working for [[Reimos Taligg]], one of Jabba's employees, infiltrated the White Thranta base in order to find evidence that the company was conspiring against Jabba. After going through the company's security files, incriminating evidence linking Durr to creepy medical experiments was found,<ref name="SWG:DI" /> and so Reimos ordered the spacer to kill Durr. It was only after Durr's death, however, that Reimos discovered that Durr was not in charge of the experiments. Upon reading his personal logs, it became clear that Durr was a lazy employee working under Brok Ziam.<ref name="SWG:SO" /> Durr had diverted funds from the company into his own private account, and was actually planning to flee the company in the days before his death.<ref name="SWG:DI" />

==Behind the scenes==
Durr Roddack was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SO" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Durr Roddack was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>

In the game, Durr Roddack was originally named '''Dren Riddick''',<ref name="SWG:SO" /><ref name="SWGTCGPOGG">[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> yet for unknown reasons the developers changed his name in the "[[:w:c:swg:Chapter 2|Chapter 2]]" update, released on [[August 1]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 2: The Talus Incident Publish Notes, August 1st">{{SonyForumsCite|full_url=http://soe.lithium.com/swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=58871|text="Chapter 2: The Talus Incident" Publish Notes, August 1st}}</ref> Furthermore, the Mos Eisley section of the "Legacy Quest" was revamped upon the release of the "[[:w:c:swg:Chapter 3|Chapter 3]]" update, on [[September 27]], 2006,<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref> and Durr Roddacks quest was strongly modified, though the story line remained similar.<ref name="SWG:SO" />
